tools.name: guide
tools.description: The vault's rules (AGENTS.md) and its index of pages. Call once before using the vault.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search wiki pages and captured sources. Returns paths, titles, review dates and snippets; wiki pages rank above raw captures. `stale: true` means the page is past its volatility window: re-verify before relying on it. `superseded_by` names the page that replaces it: read that instead. Read a page before relying on it.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read one vault file by path, e.g. 'wiki/LLM wiki maintenance.md'. Returns its text and sha (needed to replace it).

tools.name: list
tools.description: List vault file paths under a folder (e.g. 'wiki/' or 'raw/2026-11/').

tools.name: write_page
tools.description: Create or replace a wiki page (wiki/<Title>.md) or index.md. To replace, pass the sha from `read`; the write fails if the file changed since. Wiki pages need valid frontmatter (type, reviewed, volatility, sources). Also list new pages in index.md.

sha.description: sha from read, required when replacing

tools.name: capture_source
tools.description: Save a decisive source to raw/ (create-only; captured sources never change). Keep verbatim the passages that support conclusions.

tools.name: append_log
tools.description: Append one entry to log.md for a research run, ingest, or lint pass.

spend.description: Approximate paid spend for the run, e.g. ~$0.12; omit if none

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Check the vault: broken links, bad frontmatter, pages missing from the index (errors); stale and orphan pages (warnings). Run after writing.
